result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but there are a few visible layout issues involving horizontal clipping and an overlapping element in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row is horizontally clipped at the right edge, with only part of another chip visible and no clear indication that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal scrolling behavior with appropriate right padding, or show a fade/scroll cue so partially visible chips look intentional.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel under “Fastest near you” is cut off at the right edge, leaving the third card and its name visibly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has proper clipping and spacing, or make the partial-card preview clearly intentional with sufficient peek space and scroll affordance.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar overlays the bottom navigation icons, obscuring the search and center navigation controls.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray overlay or reposition the system/navigation indicator so it does not cover interactive navigation elements.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section is visible only as an image near the bottom of the viewport, with its title and metadata cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust bottom spacing or card rendering so the next card does not appear abruptly truncated above the fixed navigation bar.
